scope: Bounded read-only review of the admitted-relative-host helper, acquisition/shutdown integration, and corresponding assembler edits. Memory-policy changes are outside this review.

checks.name: Capture after successful publication
checks.evidence: acquireRunnerLock line 303 calls captureFreshAdmittedRelativeHosts only after MoveFolder publication, exact owner reread, and lockHeld=true. It passes the original acquisition inventory and original snapshot.

checks.name: Fresh acquisition only
checks.evidence: captureFreshAdmittedRelativeHosts clears the in-memory set first and returns whenever snapshot is truthy or lockHeld is false. A successful stale recovery cannot populate the exception.

checks.name: Same-owner scope
checks.evidence: The helper binds to exact lockOwnerText and requires lockHeld plus equality with that owner text at shutdown. releaseRunnerLock still rereads and requires the exact on-disk owner before deletion.

checks.name: Actual script and creation filter
checks.evidence: lockActualRelativeRunner inspects the actual WSH script argument after leading WSH options; an arbitrary later native_runner.js data argument does not qualify. Absolute drive/UNC script paths are excluded. lockCreatedNoLater requires valid full creation strings and compares timestamp plus remaining microseconds.

checks.name: Exact admitted identity
checks.evidence: The shutdown predicate requires exact numeric PID, exact full CreationDate string, and exact command string from the acquisition snapshot. It neither adds identities nor learns new exceptions during shutdown.

checks.name: Current-root protection
checks.evidence: Both capture and shutdown predicate reject commands containing the normalized current-root boundary. assertNoLockWorkers remains byte-identical and retains absolute-root worker checks.

checks.name: Only this host is filtered
checks.evidence: parallelShutdownInventory filters only the individually matched WSH host. Direct children and coordinator PID are explicitly excluded; no compiler, RAM helper, wrapper, or other descendant is exempted by association.

checks.name: Unknown and new hosts stay guarded
checks.evidence: Unreadable commands and new or changed PID/creation/command tuples cannot use the exception; they remain subject to the unchanged guard. The existing observer exemption is unchanged.

checks.name: Recovery and shutdown retained
checks.evidence: assertNoLockWorkers, quarantineStaleLock, lockSnapshotAt, identifyLockSelf, releaseRunnerLock and parallelShutdown were compared byte-for-byte as function sections against v0.2.12 and are unchanged. The observer function body is also unchanged.

checks.name: Assembler integration
checks.evidence: Assembler inserts exactly the helper, two globals, one post-publication capture call and the shutdown predicate call for this lock feature. It asserts baseline identity and unchanged guard/quarantine/release sections.

important_boundaries: The exception preserves a prior fresh-lock admission decision; it does not prove the relative host belongs to another workspace or is read-only.

The original acquisition inventory is taken before this runner launches compiler/helper work. Later descendants cannot enter the immutable recorded set. This is not a general transitive-lineage implementation.
The retained v0.2.12 stale lock is not made recoverable by this exception. Existing stale/legacy locks keep conservative recovery checks.
Windows process behavior, WMI accuracy and command-line observation remain native validation concerns.
